note: Per series [[period, value], ...]; null marks a period the source left blank (never interpolated). Monthly and quarterly series keep 15 years; daily and weekly keep every observation for a year and one per week back to 3 years. Prices of funds and futures are in closes.json, not here. `first` keeps the first value this job saw for each of the last 24 periods of a revised series (vintages accumulate from the job's start).
